description: Luw.ai 3DGen AI: generate a textured 3D model (GLB) from a photo of an object — furniture, decor, products. Add up to 3 photos from other angles for better accuracy. For text-to-3D, first make an image with luw_generate_image. Costs 3 credits (aria, the default) or 8 (symphony, which adds a high-detail texture pack on paid accounts).

engine.description: Luw.ai model: aria (the default, 3 credits) or symphony (8 credits; adds the high-detail texture pack on paid accounts). Use symphony only when the user chose it in this conversation; otherwise ask them first, with both prices.

items.description: Another angle of the same object (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

image.description: Photo of the object (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

simplify.description: 1 = lighter mesh (150K triangles instead of 500K). Free accounts always get the lighter mesh.

texture.description: High-detail texture pack: 1 = on (the default with symphony), 0 = off. Symphony engine and paid accounts only.

name: luw_image_to_3d
title: Image to 3D model (3DGen AI)
